title: Optimal Quantum-Classical Separations for Exact Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study exact learning with membership queries for concept classes $\mathcal C\subseteq\{0,1\}^N$, focusing on the relationships among their deterministic, randomized, and quantum query complexities, denoted $\mathsf{D}(\mathcal C)$, $\mathsf{R}(\mathcal C)$, and $\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)$, respectively. translated_title: 精确学习的最优量子-经典分离
translated_abstract: 我们研究概念类 $\mathcal C\subseteq\{0,1\}^N$ 在成员查询下的精确学习，重点关注其确定性查询复杂度 $\mathsf{D}(\mathcal C)$、随机化查询复杂度 $\mathsf{R}(\mathcal C)$ 和量子查询复杂度 $\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)$ 之间的关系。该模型中两种经典的量子加速分别由 Grover 搜索和 Bernstein-Vazirani 算法所体现，由此引出了一个长期存在的猜想：$$ \mathsf{R}(\mathcal C)=O(\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)^2+\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)\log N). $$ 我们首先通过构造概念类 $\mathcal C$ 和 $\mathcal C'$ 反驳了这一猜想，它们满足：\[ \mathsf{R}(\mathcal C)=\Omega\!\left(\frac{\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)^3\log N}{\log \mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C)}\right) \qquad\text{以及}\qquad \mathsf{D}(\mathcal C')=\Omega(\mathsf{Q}(\mathcal C')^3\log N). \] 其中第一个下界在常数因子范围内与 Arunachalam 等人 [Quantum'21] 的上界相匹配，而……
tldr: 本文反驳了量子精确学习中“随机化查询复杂度至多为量子查询复杂度平方加对数项”的长期猜想，构造出随机化（及确定性）查询复杂度可比量子查询复杂度高出近三次方的概念类，给出了本质上最优的量子-经典分离。
en_tdlr: This paper refutes the long-standing conjecture R=O(Q²+Q·log N) in exact quantum learning by constructing concept classes whose randomized (and deterministic) query complexities can be nearly cubic in their quantum query complexity, achieving essentially optimal quantum-classical separations.
